title: How to Plant a Tree

lines.text: Today we're going to plant a tree. First, find a sunny place in the garden.
Dig a hole about the size of a bucket.
Put the small tree in the hole. Be careful with the roots.
Fill the hole with soil and press it down gently.
Give the tree a lot of water. Use two buckets.
Water it every two days for the first month.
Finally, give your tree a name. Our tree is called Tito!

title: My Holiday in the Mountains

lines.text: Every July, I go to my grandparents' house in the mountains.
Their house is small and old, but it has a beautiful garden.
Every morning, my grandfather and I walk with the dog by the river.
In the afternoon, my cousins come, and we play football or cards.
In the evening, my grandmother makes hot chocolate and tells us stories.
There is no TV there, but I'm never bored.
I love my holidays in the mountains.
